steps: Bring the water, soy, sugar, ponzu, mirin and salt to the boil.
Add the shiitake and bonito and simmer 5 minutes.
Take off the heat, add the kombu and leave another 5 minutes to infuse. Strain.

resolvedChecks.note: The sugar is listed without a unit ("40 sugar") and isn't mentioned in the method. 40 g, added with the soy, is assumed.
resolvedChecks.resolution: 40 g sugar, added with the soy.
